description: Victory Giant Technology (HuiZhou) Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of high-precision printed circuit boards in China and internationally. The company offers artificial intelligence and computing products, including HDIs and multilayer PCBs; smart terminals, such as HDIs and FPCs for AI computers, wearable devices, and AR/VR devices; and automotive electronics comprising HDIs, high-multilayer PCBs, and FPCs for three-electric systems of energy vehicles, intelligent driving, body control modules, and smart cockpits.
